topThreats.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
topThreats.summary: CISA has added two new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, based on evidence of active exploitation.
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Evaluate organizational exposure against NIST CSF 2.0 governance metrics. Task Execution: Verify endpoint telemetry in SIEM, apply vendor security mitigations, and cross-reference internal asset databases.
